item: Row 465: per-feed outcome counter over the last 8 passes, and the per-host spacing actually applied
key_paths: src/ingest/outcome_history.py; src/ingest/spacing_stats.py; src/ingest/pipeline.py; src/ingest/__init__.py; src/api/diagnostics/source_samples.py; src/monitoring/collect_perf.py; migrations/versions/d7e3b1a9c4f2_feed_recent_outcomes.py; tests/test_outcome_history_row465.py
summary: Q3/Q11: feed_fetch_state.recent_outcomes (additive TEXT, migration d7e3b1a9c4f2 + boot self-heal, omitted from backup carry as this instance's own observation) keeps counts only for the last 8 checked passes: how the feed answered (read, 304, 4xx, 5xx, no status, robots) and how its entries ended (stored, duplicate, non-article, extract failed, 4xx, 5xx, no status, robots, Crawl-delay deferred, store error). Backed-off, Crawl-delay-deferred (Q1013 = a), switch-refused and stopped passes are not passes (R614), so no offline count exists. Source samples add recent_outcome to the class table and the window's sums to each row (a never-checked empty row stays five long, so the 200 KB part holds as many rows). Q8: collect_perf's pass summary gains host_spacing, a histogram of the gap between two requests to one host after the politeness wait, per request and per host at its tightest, with below_interval and deferred counts; no host names leave.
